Name: Slime Rancher
Author: eldritchdraaks
Description:
This mod was made for me and a friend, to go along with out slime-themed roleplay of Stardew Valley.

The contents of this mod turns all livestock, cats, dogs and horses into cute slimes, inspired by the game Slime Rancher.
[list]
[*]Fish are not affected.
[/list]
If you just want a slimey pet, slimey livestock, or just a slime horse, then this is the mod for you. Check the config to mix and match these options as you please, even toggle the text.

[quote]As of 7/21/2022, I want to dedicate this mod to Sabishi1985 on the Chucklefish forums. In 2016 she made a mod exactly like this, turning all the farm animals into slimes. I only just discovered it, and although we had a similar approach, we turned out with different designs. 

[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/slime-animals-last-update-09-10-2016.110931/]You can find Sabashi1985's Slime-Animals mod here.

[/url][u]UPDATE 4/21/2023:[/u] Sabishi1985's Slime-Animals mod has been [i]unofficially[/i] converted to work with content patcher and included in this mod as an alternative to my own sprites. I have made no edits to the original sprite work and likely will not be making any efforts to add on to Sabishi's work. The purpose of this was to revive the mod and make it easy to use again.
﻿I hope Sabishi1985 finds this.[/quote]


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/12654/12654-1682074599-261427467.png[/img]
"A trio of slime people doing slimey things."
~Eldritchdraaks[/center]
